description:
✅ Brand Introduction:

TOPG is a motivational lifestyle brand inspired by high-performance, no-excuse mindset champions like Andrew Tate. Our mission is to fuel ambition and discipline through bold, wearable statements. Whether it’s “What Color is Your Bugatti?” or “Cobra Shield,” our apparel reminds you — and everyone who sees it — to stay sharp, hustle hard, and win big.

We sell globally, reaching customers who identify with power, resilience, and Sigma mindset culture.

🧢 Product Description:

  • Premium T-Shirts – 100% cotton, soft-style fit, ethically sourced

  • Motivational Slogans – Real Tate-style quotes that resonate with fans

  • Phone Cases, Mugs, Hoodies – Durable and sleek, with viral design potential

  • Products manufactured & shipped via Printify (global POD provider)

  • Worldwide shipping available (US, UK, EU, and more)

🌟 USP (Unique Selling Points):

  • 🔥 Viral, trend-driven Andrew Tate phrases (proven sales success)

  • 👕 High-quality apparel printed & shipped from top-tier POD facilities

  • 💰 Competitive affiliate payouts (up to 30% per sale)

  • 🌎 Worldwide fulfillment

  • 🎯 Perfect for influencers in Tate / Hustle / Sigma Male / Gym niches

  • 🛒 Easy-to-navigate Shopify store for smooth customer experience

💸 Affiliate Payment Terms:

  • Payout per sale: 15%

  • Commission type: Per-sale, tracked via custom affiliate link

  • Payout method: Stripe / Wise / PayPal (based on affiliate’s preference)

  • Payment schedule: Weekly or bi-weekly (depending on volume and method)

📌 Other Info:

  • No limit on earnings — the more you sell, the more you earn.

  • We provide content ideas, product images, mockups, and captions.

  • TikTok, Reels, Shorts, IG pages, Telegram groups — all traffic allowed.

  • Affiliate dashboard is managed through [name your affiliate tool like GoAffPro, UpPromote, etc.]

🗣️ How to Join:

🖇️ Apply now through your custom affiliate sign-up link
💬 Message us for collaboration ideas or bundle drops
📈 Let’s build a viral clothing empire together!
